_comment: Config table for WhatsApp platform-dependent constants. Loaded at runtime, never hardcoded in pipeline code, because WhatsApp has changed the Status duration limit twice in under two years (30s -> 60s -> 90s). Update this file (or its DB-backed equivalent, PlatformLimit in schema.prisma) after each Milestone-2-style empirical re-validation pass.

STATUS.notes: Raised from 30s -> 60s -> 90s over 2024-2026. Resolution ceiling commonly reported at 720p despite portrait display. Re-verify empirically before every major release.

CHAT.notes: No app-enforced duration ceiling; practical ceiling driven by the 16MB re-encode trigger.

CUSTOM.notes: Bounded to WhatsApp's actual media-message compression trigger range, not an arbitrary ceiling.
